rss.descricaoPerfil: Posts open to the internet by {nome} on Alumia
rss.descricaoComunidade: Posts open to the internet in the {nome} community on Alumia

cartao.rodape: on Alumia, the network of Instituto Lúcia

folha.intro: Everything here is made on your device: the image and the QR code do not go through any outside service.
folha.naoCopiou: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

arte.ajuda: An image of the post to send to a group or post on another network.
arte.comQr: Add the link's QR code to the image
arte.falhou: Could not make the image on this device.

qr.ajuda: On a banner, a poster or a screen: whoever points a camera at it opens the page.
qr.falhou: Could not make the QR code on this device.

embed.ajuda: A text-only frame, with nothing that runs on the other site: it shows the post and the button to read it on Alumia. If the post stops being open to the internet, the frame stops showing it.
embed.conferindo: Checking whether the post can go out…
embed.indisponivel: This post does not go out to other sites. Only top-level posts open to the internet, from a profile or an open community, go out.

comunidade.rssAjuda: This community's posts open to the internet, in any RSS reader, with no account.
comunidade.rssIndisponivel: This community has no RSS: only open communities, and only with posts open to the internet.

listas.intro: The list is yours alone: nobody else sees who you follow. Download it to take to another Fediverse network, or bring it from there.
listas.entrar: Log in to take and bring the list of who you follow.

exportar.ajuda: The file works on other Fediverse networks, such as Mastodon.
exportar.vazia: You do not follow anyone yet.

importar.ajuda: Choose the file the other network gave you, or paste the addresses as @name@server, one per line. You check before following.
importar.resumo: {daqui} from here · {fora} from other Fediverse networks
importar.ignoradas: Lines that were not addresses and were left out: {n}.
importar.demais: The first {n} go in this time. Bring the rest afterwards.

fediverso.aviso: To follow someone from another instance, turn on the Fediverse in your profile.

perfil.rssOrg: This organization's posts open to the internet, in any RSS reader.
perfil.rssPessoa: Profile RSS is only for organizations with a seal. Your posts open to the internet go out through the RSS of the open communities where you write.

ajustes.texto: Download the list of who you follow, bring one from another instance and get your profile's QR code.
